title: Fix Shared Ingredient List Links to Open Web View
description: Ensure ingredient list sharing links open a web page instead of API JSON, and enforce viewer/editor behavior in shared-link access.

tasks.title: Route share links to web UI and support editor/viewer shared access
acceptance_criteria: Share link generation and email invites produce URLs that point to /ingredient-lists/shared/{token} instead of /api/ingredient-lists/shared/{token}
Web frontend provides a shared ingredient-list page at /ingredient-lists/shared/{token} for anonymous access
Viewer links can read but not mutate shared list ingredients
Editor links can add, update, and remove ingredients through token-scoped API endpoints
ApiService and Web projects build successfully
tasks.notes: Implemented frontend-facing share URL generation for email and link share flows, added anonymous shared-list page at /ingredient-lists/shared/{token}, and added token-scoped ingredient mutation endpoints enforcing Editor-only writes. ApiService/Web builds pass. Evaluator verdict: PASS.

dependencies: Uses existing ListShareToken model and AccessLevel fields
Keeps existing owner/shared-user authenticated endpoints unchanged
